import re

def parse_phone_date(date_str):
    month_map = {'January':1,'February':2,'March':3,'April':4,'May':5,'June':6,'July':7,'August':8,'September':9,'October':10,'November':11,'December':12}
    m2 = re.search(r',\s*([A-Za-z]+)\s+(\d{1,2}),\s*(\d{4})$', date_str.strip())
    if not m2:
        return None, None
    month = month_map.get(m2.group(1))
    year = int(m2.group(3))
    return year, month

# Login Amazon

now = apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()
year, month = parse_phone_date(now['date'])

# Choose a valid payment card (not expired)
cards = apis.amazon.show_payment_cards(access_token=amz_access)
valid_cards = []
for c in cards:
    ey = int(c.get('expiry_year'))
    em = int(c.get('expiry_month'))
    is_valid = (ey > year) or (ey == year and em >= month)
    if is_valid:
        valid_cards.append(c)

if not valid_cards:
    raise Exception('No valid payment cards')

payment_card_id = valid_cards[0]['payment_card_id']

# Ensure cart contains the selected product
